activity.notes: Representative historical PERSON-SPECIFIC milestone point (not a claim of a single year of career). 1874 first Impressionist group exhibition in Paris, named after Monet's Impression, Sunrise (painted 1872). The point records influence in France during the Third Republic; it is not a claim that his entire oeuvre was produced only in 1874.
